answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the delta queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 220 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the canyon. The vine index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 414 account operation therefore ties up 37 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
